entities.name: Chloromethyl methyl ether
observations: MOMCl is the electrophile used to install a methoxymethyl protecting group on a phenolic oxygen.

entities.name: Protocatechualdehyde
observations: 3,4-Dihydroxybenzaldehyde contains an aldehyde and two nonequivalent phenolic OH groups.
NaH/MOMCl conditions are consistent with mono- or bis-MOM protection of the phenolic OH groups while retaining the aldehyde.

entities.name: Mono-MOM protection of protocatechualdehyde
observations: NaH deprotonates a phenolic OH; the phenoxide undergoes SN2 substitution with chloromethyl methyl ether to form an Ar-O-CH2-O-CH3 ether.
The exact major regioisomer is not established from the supplied record; either phenolic position may be MOM-protected.
If two equivalents are used, bis-MOM protection is possible.
